mcpDetailBlock.title: MCP Detail
mcpDetailBlock.description: An MCP resource detail page that keeps connection credentials in product-owned callbacks while providing safe local interaction states.
mcpDetailBlock.dataBoundaryBody: The block receives complete resource data and never fetches, stores, or logs connection values. Connect onRequestConnection and onRunTool in the product layer.
mcpDetailBlock.mockBehaviorBody: The preview generates an explicitly non-sensitive example connection and runs deterministic example tool results when callbacks are omitted.
mcpDetailBlock.interactionBody: The three configuration controls are disabled while a connection request is active. Changing a value removes old connection data; expired values are cleared from memory. Tool input accepts JSON objects only.
mcpDetailBlock.responsiveBody: At xl the primary content is placed left and the 407px quickstart rail is right. Below xl the DOM remains Aside-first, so configuration appears before the longer service content.
